council_notes: Market-shock overlay active: geopolitical_macro_risk_off severity=0.62 stance=hedged_only.
Avoid naked call chasing while headlines dominate index direction.
Allow only high-confidence, low-extrinsic picks; keep rejected candidates in shadow.
Side-balance guard demoted an over-concentrated position to shadow.
Council is operating under a neutral market regime.

policy.promotion_rule: Promote only if shadow beats active when they disagree, after costs, out of sample, without worse drawdown.
